> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from Elsevier publisher pages and domain knowledge of educational-psychology editorial culture. > **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Contemporary educational psychology — motivation theory (achievement goals, self-determination), self-regulated learning, cognitive load theory, instructional design, achievement emotions, technology-enhanced learning |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (soft)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **contemporary educational psychology contribution** — current theoretical advances in learning, motivation, instruction, or assessment.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure educational research without psychology theory redirected to AERA journals.

Reviewers from educational-psychology research community — APA Division 15 / AERA Division C overlaps. Common demands: "Theoretical contribution to educational psychology?", "Ecological validity in classroom?", "Practical implications for instruction?".

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts without educational-psychology framing
- AI use without disclosure per Elsevier policy
- Pure educational research without psychology theory

### Soft Tax

Low for educational-psychology tradition authors. 24-month AAM embargo on subscription path.

### Best Suited For

- Motivation theory empirical research (achievement goals, SDT)
- Self-regulated learning studies
- Cognitive load and instructional design
- Achievement emotions research
- Technology-enhanced learning empirical work
- Multilevel classroom designs
- Educational psychology meta-analyses

### Not Recommended For

- Pure educational research without psychology theory (consider AERA journals)
- Pure qualitative work
- Pure clinical / counseling psychology

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Educational Psychology](./journal-of-educational-psychology.md) | APA flagship for educational psychology |
| 2 | [Educational Psychology Review](./educational-psychology-review.md) | If reframed as integrative review; Springer |
| 3 | [British Journal of Educational Psychology](./british-journal-of-educational-psychology.md) | BPS-affiliated; UK educational psychology |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from J Edu Psych as "good but not flagship-level," Contemporary Educational Psychology is the Elsevier peer.
